source.title: Carboxymethyl Chitosan and Gelatin Hydrogel Scaffolds Incorporated with Conductive PEDOT Nanoparticles for Improved Neural Stem Cell Proliferation and Neuronal Differentiation

processing.evidence: The polymerization was carried out in a vibrator with a slight vibration at RT for 72 h

degradation_time.evidence: while the CMCS/Gel-0.2EDOT hydrogel showed about (36.26 ± 1.27)% weight loss

biology.cell_type: neural stem cells from fetal Sprague Dawley rat hippocampus

culture_days.evidence: after being cultured in the proliferation medium for 5 days, NSCs were grown in the differentiation condition for an additional 3 days

other_outcomes.evidence: after being cultured for 12 days, the CMCS/Gel-0.15EDOT and the CMCS/Gel-0.2EDOT scaffolds caused the highest ((236.41 ± 4.51)% and (261.02 ± 5.97)%, respectively) increase in cell viability
other_outcomes.name: CCK-8 cell viability increase

other_outcomes.evidence: the relative gene expression of β-tubulin III in cells in the CMCS/Gel-0.2EDOT hydrogel was (1.38 ± 0.10)-fold, higher than that in the CMCS/Gel hydrogel
other_outcomes.name: β-tubulin III relative gene expression vs CMCS/Gel

other_outcomes.evidence: the GFAP expression was slightly lower (0.88 ± 0.04)
other_outcomes.name: GFAP relative gene expression vs CMCS/Gel

notes: Porosity 92.52% reported. Highest conductivity formulation; degradation in PBS with 2 mg/mL lysozyme at 37 °C.
